mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate below 2% over the next 20 trading days signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to compressed discount rates applied to equity cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline below 2% over the 20-day horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals weakening labor market conditions and reduced consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the 5-day window
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 4.5% threshold, or 5-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer demand (GDPC1) and decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a dual expansionary signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise while FEDFUNDS declines over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 signals excess capacity, which may suppress near-term returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 105.0 in the late-cycle expansion regime, or 20-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in household spending (HOUST) exceeding 1200 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals robust consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 1200 units in the 5-day window
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 1200 units, or 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling Federal Funds Rates (FEDFUNDS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) creates a dual expansionary signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline while UNRATE falls over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rapid growth in industrial production (INDPRO) above 108.0 indicates rebounding supply chains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 108.0 in the post-shock recovery regime, or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 in the monetary tightening cycle signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 110.0 in the monetary tightening cycle, or 60-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
